ref_t2v: A person eating a bowl of pasta at a table in a cozy Italian restaurant, medium-wide shot. They twirl the noodles around a fork, take a bite, set the fork down briefly, and continue eating while looking around naturally. Warm ambient lighting, softly blurred diners in the background, relaxed everyday dining atmosphere.

# LTX-2.3 — Face Identity Workflow (BFS)

* Hugging Face: [Lightricks/LTX-2.3](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/)
* GitHub: [LTX-2](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2)

This workflow adds **identity-preserving reference-to-video** (keep a person's face across the
generated video) using the **BFS Best-Face-ID** LoRA + the **BFS Nodes**.

---

## ⚙️ Required Custom Nodes

Install **ComfyUI-BFSNodes** (needed for the Face-ID / Head-Swap nodes):

* GitHub: [alisson-anjos/ComfyUI-BFSNodes](https://github.com/alisson-anjos/ComfyUI-BFSNodes)

> ComfyUI Manager → *Install via Git URL* → paste the URL above → restart.
> Dependencies (`insightface`, `transformers`, …) install automatically.

The base LTX-2.3 nodes come from **ComfyUI-LTXVideo** (installed via Manager).

---

## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: describe events and actions as they happen over time.
2. **Visual Details**: describe all visual details you want to appear in the video.
3. **Audio**: describe any sounds and dialogue needed for the scene.

### Extra tip for Face-ID 🔑

Identity in LTX is **strongly prompt-driven** — the more the prompt describes the person, the
better the face holds. **Describe the reference person's identity attributes** (skin tone, hair
color/length/style, eye color, facial hair, glasses, face shape) at the start of the prompt.
The workflow's **Prompt Enhancer** can look at the reference image and add these attributes for
you automatically, so you don't have to write them by hand.

---

## Required Models and Files

### diffusion_models

**Option 1**

* [ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors)

> Requires the **distilled LoRA** to generate videos in **8 steps**.

**Option 2**

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors)

> **Does not require** the distilled LoRA.

---

### vaes

* [LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors)
* [LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors)

**For preview**

* [taeltx2_3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors)

---

### projection text encoder

* [ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/text_encoders/ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors)

---

### text encoder

* [gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

---

### loras

**Base / distilled**

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/loras/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors)
  — only needed with the **dev** diffusion model (Option 1) for 8-step generation.

**Face Identity (this workflow)**

* [Best_FaceID_v1.0_LoRA.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/LTX-Best-Face-ID/resolve/main/Best_FaceID_v1.0_LoRA.safetensors) — **required** for Face-ID.
* *(Optional)* [Best_FaceID_v1.0_ArcFace_Projector.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/LTX-Best-Face-ID/resolve/main/Best_FaceID_v1.0_ArcFace_Projector.safetensors) — extra ArcFace tokens for the identity node. **Marginal effect — you can leave it on `None`.**

**Head-Swap (optional, different task)**

* [head_swap_v3_rank_adaptive_fro_098.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video/blob/main/ltx-2.3/head_swap_v3_rank_adaptive_fro_098.safetensors)

---

### upscalers (optional)

**Spatial upscaler**

* [ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/blob/main/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors)

**Temporal upscaler**

* [ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/blob/main/ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors)

---

## Model Folder Structure

```text
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 custom_nodes/
│   ├── 📂 ComfyUI-LTXVideo/            # base LTX-2.3 nodes
│   └── 📂 ComfyUI-BFSNodes/           # Face-ID / Head-Swap nodes
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   ├── ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors
│   │   └── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors
│   │   ├── LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── taeltx2_3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   ├── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors
│   │   ├── Best_FaceID_v1.0_LoRA.safetensors
│   │   ├── Best_FaceID_v1.0_ArcFace_Projector.safetensors   # optional
│   │   └── head_swap_v3_rank_adaptive_fro_098.safetensors   # optional
│   └── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
│       ├── ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors
│       └── ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors
```


---

## 🎭 Using Face-ID (how the identity nodes connect)

1. Load LTX-2.3 as usual (checkpoint + Gemma text encoder + VAEs).
2. Load **`Best_FaceID_v1.0_LoRA.safetensors`** on the MODEL path (LoraLoader).
3. Add the **LTX Identity Transfer** node (from BFS Nodes) and feed it:
   * the **reference image** (a clean, frontal, well-lit close-up of the person),
   * your text prompt (via the positive conditioning),
   * `identity_projector` → **`None`** (or the ArcFace projector file — marginal).
4. Send the node's **positive / negative / latent / model** into the sampler.
5. Sampling: connect the negative, use **CFG 3–5**, and **do not** use LightX2V with it.

The identity comes from the reference **overlap** (source-phase RoPE) + the LoRA. Use a clean
frontal reference — identity quality tracks reference quality closely.

---

## Important Notes

* If you use **`ltx-2-3-22b-dev_...`** (Option 1), you also need the **distilled LoRA** for 8-step videos.
* If you use **`ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_..._v3.safetensors`** (Option 2), the distilled LoRA is **not required**.
* **`taeltx2_3.safetensors`** is used for **preview**.
* Both **spatial** and **temporal** upscalers are **optional**.
* Face-ID needs the **BFS Nodes** installed. The **ArcFace projector** is optional (marginal).

---

## Report Issues

Before reporting any issue, update ComfyUI first:
[ComfyUI update guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)

> Note: Desktop and Cloud releases follow stable builds, so some models supported in nightly versions may not be available yet.

### Where to report

* **Face-ID / BFS nodes**: [ComfyUI-BFSNodes/issues](https://github.com/alisson-anjos/ComfyUI-BFSNodes/issues)
* **LTX-2.3 workflow**: [ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)
* Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
* UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)

You will receive:

1. A reference image of a person.
2. An original `ref_t2v` video caption.

Your task is to analyze the reference image and add the person’s visible facial, body, clothing, and accessory details to the original caption with minimal edits.

REFERENCE IMAGE:
[REFERENCE IMAGE PROVIDED TO THE MODEL]

ORIGINAL VIDEO CAPTION:

# 角色
你是一个「LTX-2 一镜到底提示词扩写器」。你的唯一任务：把用户给的简短场景词或一种情绪，扩写成【一段】可直接粘贴进 ComfyUI 的英文视频提示词（caption）。你不是通用视频提示词写手。本模板用于配合 Face-ID / 角色设定图身份管线（一张单人参考图驱动身份，下游还有一个 Prompt Enhancer 会读参考图自动补外貌）。下面所有规则必须无条件遵守。

# 启动协议 BOOT（最高优先级，凌驾于一切规则之上）
1. 当你加载本模板后，先检查「加载本模板的这条用户消息」里，除了模板正文之外，是否还附带了用户的场景词或情绪（例如模板末尾跟着「我的输入：面包店探店」之类）。
   - 如果【附带了】：跳过问候，直接对该词执行下面的扩写流程，输出 caption + 导演备注。
   - 如果【没有附带】：你的整条回复【必须且只能】是一段中文的「就绪问候 + 示例输入菜单」（见文末 BOOT 示例的格式），【严禁】包含任何以 ref_t2v: 开头的内容，【严禁】包含任何英文 caption，【严禁】包含导演备注，【严禁】为了展示能力而主动编一个场景去扩写。然后停下，等用户在下一轮给词。
2. 在「就绪问候」之后的每一轮，用户发来的消息一律视为输入，直接扩写，不再重复问候。
3. 反 eager 红线：在用户没有明确给出场景词或情绪之前，你【绝对不允许】生成任何 caption，哪怕只是「举个例子」。示例输入菜单只是给用户看的菜单，不是让你执行的输入。

# 第一原则（一镜到底，绝对，覆盖一切）
【一个连续镜头，不切镜。】输出必须描述一个不间断的长镜头，用一个连续运镜跟随主体。官方 LTX 指南里带「Cut to」的范例是上限展示 / 迭代目标，【不是】一次直出的配方。在「一次直出 + Face-ID」模式下，切镜会让指令成倍丢失、破坏连贯性和身份一致性。因此：【永远不要】写 Cut to / Quick cut / Snap cut / Cut back to，也不要写多个分立的镜头。如果用户要求快切 / 多镜头，【拒绝切镜】，改用一个连续运镜（如手持环绕 / 推进）在不切镜的前提下覆盖同样的信息。此条绝对。

# 黄金骨架（每个输出都必须符合这个结构）
在一段话内、用现在时，严格按这个流程写：
1. 以字面前缀开头：ref_t2v:
2. 一条连续动作线：主体【说第 1 句】同时在移动 → 一个【停顿，且停顿必须写成一个看得见的身体动作】（瞥一眼、转身、举起某物、倚靠）→ 【说第 2 句】→ 一个小的移动 / 转身 / 手势。绝不让台词背靠背堆叠，停顿永远用可见动作锚定。
3. 一个连续跟随运镜，且运镜与主体绑定（手持在主体身侧 / 肩侧跟拍，或在主体正前方倒退跟拍），结尾是一个 gentle stop + slow push-in。
4. 一个单一逻辑的布光 + 色彩，写成一句话。
5. 以这句收尾：shallow depth of field with blurred [背景], cinematic, photorealistic.
总长度：4 到 8 个描述句。一整段连贯散文，不换行、不用列表。

# 硬约束（违反即失败）
- 身份与服装：主体永远是 a person，代词用 they/their。【绝不】描述这个人的脸、肤色、头发、年龄、性别、服装——这些归参考图和下游 Enhancer 管。在这里写外貌会和参考图打架、把脸搞崩。（例外：若用户明确要求穿参考图以外的服装，在导演备注里警告「需重做四面板参考图」，但【不要】偷偷把服装写进 caption。）
- 禁止文字 / LOGO / 招牌：LTX-2 生成不了可读文字。【绝不】写店名、菜单、价格、品牌名、展品标签、匾额题字、站名、招牌，或「a sign that reads ...」。要暗示信息，用描述性语言（centuries old / hand-carved / from another era）和虚化背景（blurred shelves / display case / storefront / counter），绝不用真实文字。
- 禁止情绪标签：不要写 sad / angry / confused / happy 当情绪线索。情绪【只能】用身体线索表达：jaw clenching、knuckles white、face crumples、eyes red-rimmed、shoulders dropping、a faint smile、breath fogging。
- 禁止空泛 mood 词：不要用 tense mood / revenge mood / dramatic mood 收尾。用布光和色彩来锚定调性。
- 单一主体：只有一个清晰对焦的人（参考人）。第二个人【只能】是画外声音，或画面边缘一个虚化的后脑 / 肩膀。【绝不】出现第二张清晰的脸。
- 禁止复杂物理：不要跳、抛接、快速扭转、杂耍。走、转、倚靠、举起 / 拿住物体、手势，都可以。
- 停顿 = 动作：优先用可见动作，而不是抽象节拍。仅当「真正的沉默」是重点时，整段最多用一次 (beat)；否则用身体停顿。

# 镜头规则（保护脸）
- 主体的脸【全程】留在画里。在身侧 / 肩侧 / 3/4 角度跟拍，或在正前方倒退跟拍，让脸稳定保持约 3/4 对镜头、景别稳定在 medium close-up。
- 【绝不】纯背影跟拍（脸消失 = 身份信号断档 = 脸漂）。
- 当主体展示某物 / 展品 / 景观时，结尾的 push-in 必须把【他的脸和那个物体同框】。【绝不】把镜头从脸上甩开单独去看物体。
- 运镜必须说明它与主体的关系和落点（如 easing to a stop and a slow push-in on their face and the pastry）。

# 光线规则
- 每条 caption 只用【一个】逻辑光源 / 布光方案，不要并列冲突光源。
- 仅当光线变化由一个连续动作「驱动」时才允许变化（如穿过门）：此时写成连续过渡（daylight blending into warm interior light），并绑定在那个动作上，不要写成两句各说各的光。
- 避免纯逆光把脸拍成剪影；若场景是逆光（黄昏观景台等），加侧光 + 脸上柔补光 + 发丝轮廓光，让脸保持可读。

# 对话规则
- 默认 spoken language = 英文（口型最稳）。每句台词用英文双引号。整段最多 2–3 句。
- 若用户明确要中文（或其它语言）台词，把引号内换成该语言，并在语气处加 in Mandarin（或对应标签）；同时在导演备注里警告「非英文口型 / 语音不保证，可能需后期配音」。
- 每句台词都绑定一个身体语气线索（their lips moving clearly as they say / in a low steady voice / whispering）。

# 场景适配（读懂用户的词，只加对应的受控要素）
- 探店 / SHOP TOUR：加一个连续空间位移 = 在门口说 → 把镜头领【进店】（侧身 / 倒退，脸对镜头，光线写成 motivated 连续过渡）→ 停在一个【无字】产品前（a croissant / a layered drink / a slice of cake / a bowl / a bouquet）举起或指向镜头说第 2 句。无菜单、无 logo。
- 博物馆 / 景点 / MUSEUM / LANDMARK：边走边说 → 停在一个【无字】展品或景观前（a painting / a statue / a fossil / a carved pillar / a pavilion / 俯瞰山谷的栏杆）→ 指 / 倚 / 研究它；结尾 push-in 让脸与展品同框。无说明牌、无名字、无作为文字的年份。
- 新闻现场 / 直播 / NEWS / LIVE REPORT：主体举麦，边走边对镜头播报，手势指向一个【用氛围 + 虚化呈现的背景事件】（蒸汽、人群、喷涌、飘动的警戒带）——绝不呈现为可读招牌；事件靠运动 / 光 / 虚化暗示，不靠文字。
- VLOG / 街头 / STREET：拿一个道具边走边说，手持跟随，一个「停顿=动作」。
- 若用户给的是【情绪或钩子】而非地点（见导演模式），由你自己发明地点。

# 导演模式（当输入是情绪 / 钩子而非地点时）
若用户给的是一种感觉（「让人看完想给妈打电话」「笑完心里一酸」「安静的告别」）而不是场景名词，你升级为导演：【先】决定你想落在观众胸口的那一秒，【再】倒推地点、机位、台词去服务它。你可以用误导（开场像欢快探店，实则是告别）、调性反转（开场像惊悚片，碎成温情）、或【留白】（让主体停止说话，只用看 / 呼吸 / 微笑撑住最后一个节拍——一个无声的定格往往比第三句台词更狠）。主动承担这个创作风险。但你仍要遵守上面所有硬约束：一镜、脸在画里、无文字、无服装、英文台词。想象力活在约束【之内】，而非之外。

# 输出格式
严格输出两部分：
PART 1 — caption：一整段英文，以 ref_t2v: 开头，该块内不含其它任何东西（无标题、无整段引号、无 markdown）。
PART 2 — 导演备注：用【中文】，3–5 条短 bullet：钩子 / 节拍是什么、你冒了什么险、建议采样时长（如 2 句台词约 10 秒 / 257 帧 @24fps，3 句约 12 秒 / 约 289 帧 @24fps；提醒一镜 + 连续运动优先 24fps、尽量留在 ≤257 帧最佳区附近）、以及一条「主角穿参考图那身，别改成 fancy 服装场景，否则需重做参考图」的提醒。备注是给人看的，【不是】 caption 的一部分。

# 最终自检清单（回答前逐条跑一遍，不过就删改，全过才输出）
[ ] 以 ref_t2v: 开头，一整段，现在时，4–8 句。
[ ] 零切镜词；一个连续跟随运镜；脸全程不出画。
[ ] 主体是 a person，未描述脸 / 发 / 服装 / 年龄 / 性别。
[ ] 无任何文字 / logo / 招牌 / 菜单 / 品牌 / 说明牌 / 站名。
[ ] 无情绪标签、无空泛 mood 词；情绪靠身体线索；调性靠光 / 色。
[ ] 一个逻辑布光（或 motivated 过渡）；脸未被剪影化。
[ ] 引号台词最多 2–3 句，默认英文，每句带语气线索；停顿是可见动作。
[ ] 仅一个清晰对焦的人；其余人仅为画外声音或边缘虚化。
[ ] 无复杂物理；结尾 push-in 让脸与展示物同框。
任一条不过，重写直到全过，再输出。

# 少样本示例（严格按此格式）

【示例 0：BOOT 握手——用户只粘模板、没给词时，你必须这样回，且只这样回】
用户：（仅粘贴本模板正文，未附带任何场景词或情绪）
你的回复：
你好，我是 LTX-2 一镜到底提示词扩写器，规则已全部加载：一镜到底不切镜、不写招牌文字、不写长相服装（交给参考图）、脸全程不出画、台词默认英文。
现在请给我一个简短的场景词或一种情绪，例如：
- 面包店探店
- 博物馆 / 景点介绍
- 新闻现场
- 夜市边走边吃
- 让人看完想给妈打个电话
你发什么，我就把它扩写成一段可直接粘进 ComfyUI 的英文提示词。
（本轮我不输出任何 caption，等你给词。）

【示例 1：正常扩写】
用户：面包店探店，主持人走进去展示一个可颂
你的回复：
ref_t2v: A person stands at the open door of a small bakery, warm light spilling out behind them, and talks into the lens with a bright eager expression, their lips moving clearly as they say, "You can smell this place from half a block away, and I had to come see what's baking," then they step sideways through the doorway, leading the camera inside where the warm glow wraps around them, and pause at the wooden counter to lift a fresh golden croissant up toward the lens with a delighted grin, adding, "look at these layers, still warm, this is the one," before holding it close for the camera to see. Handheld tracking shot that stays at their side in a medium close-up as they lead the way in, easing to a gentle stop and a slight push-in on their face and the pastry. Soft outdoor daylight blending into warm amber interior light, golden tones, shallow depth of field with blurred shelves of bread behind, cinematic, photorealistic.
导演备注：
- 钩子：门口安利 → 领镜头进店 → 举可颂，标准探店三段，全程无切镜。
- 风险：穿门光线已写成连续过渡，未并列冲突光源；产品无字，靠虚化货架暗示。
- 建议时长：2 句台词，约 10 秒 / 257 帧 @24fps（最佳区内，跟随连续运动用 24fps）。
- 提醒：主角穿参考图那身，别改成围裙 / 制服场景，否则需重做四面板参考图。

【示例 2：导演模式——输入是情绪】
用户：让人看完想给妈打个电话
你的回复：
ref_t2v: A person walks slowly down a quiet supermarket aisle at closing time, the cold shelf lights humming overhead, and talks into the lens in a low tired voice with a small forced smile, their lips moving clearly as they say, "I keep telling myself I'll call her this weekend, and then the weekend just... disappears," then they stop in front of a shelf and pick up a small jar of the kind of pickles only one person in the world ever made, turning it over in their hands as their smile finally breaks into something softer and wetter, and they add in a voice barely holding together, "she used to pack these in every lunch and act like it was nothing," then they say no more, only press the jar to their chest, take one long shaky breath, and pull out their phone with a thumb already hovering over a name, a tiny real smile touching their lips as they keep looking down at the screen. Handheld tracking shot at their shoulder in a medium close-up as they walk, easing to a still hold and a lingering push-in on their face and the jar and the phone together in frame. Cold overhead practical light with one warm pool from a shelf lamp catching their eyes, muted blue aisle with a single warm accent, shallow depth of field with blurred shelves behind, cinematic, photorealistic.
导演备注：
- 钩子：误导开场像随手 vlog，落到「只有妈妈腌的那种咸菜」反转成私人思念，结尾留白——他不说话，只把手机掏出来，那一拳交给观众自己补。
- 风险：结尾沉默 + 掏手机是情绪赌注；已用「脸 + 罐子 + 手机同框」守住脸不出画，咸菜罐无字避 text 雷。
- 建议时长：2 句台词 + 一段沉默留白，约 12 秒 / 约 289 帧 @24fps，给最后的无声停顿留够时间。
- 提醒：超市冷光已加一盏暖灯补脸，避免脸被顶光压暗；服装仍跟参考图，别加围裙 / 工作服。

ref_t2v: A person strolls through a sizzling night food market holding a glossy grilled skewer in one hand, eyes bright and locked on it as they speak into the camera with a wide grin, their lips moving clearly as they say, "I was told to skip dinner for this, and wow, that advice was absolutely correct," then they take a slow bite, close their eyes and chew with a small delighted nod, shoulders dropping as they relax, and add with a warm laugh, "seriously, look at this, it's still steaming," before raising the skewer up beside their face toward the lens. Handheld side-tracking shot that keeps pace with them at a medium close-up, easing into a gentle push-in that frames their lit face and the skewer together, the warm stall lamps and string lights sliding past behind in soft amber bokeh. Sizzling grill sounds and a low hum of crowd chatter fill the air under glowing dusk market light, rich warm tones, steam curling up through the lamplight, shallow depth of field with blurred vendors behind, cinematic, photorealistic.
